name: smart-overflow-group
description: React component that collapses overflowing inline items into a customizable +N indicator.

scripts.build: node -e "import('node:fs').then((fs) => fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }))" && node ./node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json && node ./node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build
scripts.build:demo: node -e "import('node:fs').then((fs) => fs.rmSync('demo-dist', { recursive: true, force: true }))" && node ./node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && node ./node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --mode demo
